correctness.rationale: For each prefix, the exact undominated vertices are pairs of unused ground vertices plus isolated selected edges. All five legal move types and the conservation law \(L=n-u-b_1-c_2\) are proved with full endpoint cases. The terminal cases force \(L\le n-1\) and parity forces \(n-2\) for even order. Tight constructions exist; equality in odd order forces ordered matching followed by root-and-pair attachments, whose independent factorial counting gives \(n!(n-1)!/2^{(n-1)/2}\). Contracting a near-perfect matching proves the unordered tree-support criterion. Independent exact neighborhood DP checks all \(3\le n\le11\); matching/attachment generator independently confirms odd \(n=3,5,7\); finite checks corroborate but are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The exact number of optimal ordered legal total-dominating histories is an intrinsically combinatorial and natural invariant, distinct from mere maximum length or ordinary total domination. The nontrivial parity obstruction forces an \(m\)-step near-perfect matching phase then \(m\)-step attachment phase; complete tree-support characterization and factorial enumeration form a reusable structural account of extremal histories for the natural line graphs of cliques. This is neither a renamed known formula nor an arbitrary small finite slice.
